question: What post-subagent completion contract should OpenClaw support, and how should it bound child output/history exposure, announcement mutation or suppression, and delivery-result visibility?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but payload shape, redaction, plugin authority, ordering, timeout behavior, and the relationship to the rejected guard-hook PR are public API and security-boundary choices that automation should not lock in.

options.title: Typed delivery hook
options.body: Add a bounded typed hook at the post-child-result/pre-announcement seam with explicit metadata, redaction, timeout, audit, and return semantics for enrichment or suppression.

options.title: Generic boundary first
options.body: Fold the request into a broader product-driven output or delivery boundary so subagent completion filtering does not become a one-off public API.

options.title: Observation-only event
options.body: Expose only a non-mutating completion event and leave announcement mutation or suppression to separate delivery-policy work such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/13911.

recommendation.title: Typed delivery hook
recommendation.body: Add a bounded typed hook at the post-child-result/pre-announcement seam with explicit metadata, redaction, timeout, audit, and return semantics for enrichment or suppression.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent core subagent thread-binding work and the maintainer review closing the overlapping guard-hook PR make this the strongest available owner for the product/security boundary choice.
